corridor_notes: Main trunk of the 苏皖豫干线 (Su-Wan-Yu / Jiangsu-Anhui-Henan trunk) project, PipeChina Group. Per the MEE Nov-2025 EIA approval: '干线起自江苏省盐城市通榆分输清管站，止于河南省平顶山市鲁山东压气站' (starts at Tongyu Distribution & Pigging Station, Yancheng, Jiangsu; ends at Lushan East Compressor Station, Pingdingshan, Henan). Corridor crosses 14 prefecture-level cities across 3 provinces: Jiangsu (Yancheng, Lianyungang, Huai'an, Suqian, Xuzhou), Anhui (Huaibei, Suzhou, Bozhou, Fuyang), Henan (Zhoukou, Shangqiu, Zhumadian, Luohe, Pingdingshan). Length is cited two ways across sources: the earlier EIA public-participation notice (pipechina.com.cn) and a construction bid-award article (sohu) both give 796.6 km, matching GEM's LengthMergedKm exactly; the final Nov-2025 MEE approval gives 823.8 km / DN1219mm / 10 MPa design pressure / 18.3 bcm/y capacity for the as-approved main trunk — likely a pre-final-design vs. as-approved delta, not a routing error.

map_or_vector.desc: 1032-page full Environmental Impact Report (环境影响报告书) for the 苏皖豫干线项目（滨海-鲁山）, uploaded to doc88.com Sep 2025. Almost certainly contains detailed route maps for the whole network (main trunk + Xuzhou liaison + Sihong branch), but was not opened/traced for this deliverable — flagged for a human GIS pass if finer route geometry is wanted.

researcher_notes: High-confidence: both endpoints are named, specific facilities (distribution/pigging station and compressor station) confirmed identically across three independent Chinese-language sources (official MEE approval document, PipeChina's own EIA public-participation notice, and a construction-bid news article), all giving the same start/end wording. Only the exact pipe length differs slightly (796.6 vs 823.8 km) between the pre-final EIA notice and the final Nov-2025 approval — not a location discrepancy.
blockers: Station-level coordinates are not resolvable in OpenStreetMap/Nominatim for either facility (both are recently-built PipeChina infrastructure, likely not yet mapped in OSM); used township centroid for the start (Tongyu Town) and county centroid for the end (Lushan County) as the finest available fallback. A human GIS pass against the full EIA report PDF (doc88 link above) could refine both to exact station coordinates.
